values.note: FS: 65 campsites, standard electric, non-electric and tent. The recreation.gov catalog lists 47 (43 take RVs, 4 tent-only), catalogued at 25-45 ft (003 reads 99, a placeholder); many pull-throughs. Nine electric sites in the upper loop (048-068). One camping unit per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lakeview-campground-gunnison-rd ('There are 65 campsites including standard electric/nonelectric and tent camping') + recreation.gov catalog 232154 (Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry) + notice 'Recreation Use Fee allows ONE camping unit ONLY', read 2026-10-28

values.note: Late spring to early fall, weather dependent (FS).

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/lakeview-campground-gunnison-rd ('Seasons of Use: Late Spring to Early Fall - weather dependent'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: A mix of reservable and first-come sites; the whole campground is first-come before and after the reservation season (2026: May 15 - Jun 18 and Sep 13 - Oct 11). First-come sites are booked in person only. Booking closes 4 days before arrival; two nights on weekends (not marked soft). A late reservation is held 24 hours. Extra vehicles $13-23 a night, paid to the host.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232154 (rules maxConsecutiveStay 14, minWeekendStay 2, reservationCutOff 4; notices) + /rates (2026 First-come 05-15 to 06-18, Peak 06-19 to 09-12, First-come 09-13 to 10-11) + FS page ('combination of first come, first serve and reservable campsites'; 'Additional Vehicle Fee: $13-$23 per night'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $26 non-electric, $36 electric ($10 electric fee), same rate first-come and peak; 2027 unchanged.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232154/rates (2026 Peak and First-come STANDARD/RV NONELECTRIC 26, STANDARD ELECTRIC 36; 2027 the same) + FS page ('Single Site Non-Electric: $26 per night | Single Site Electric: $36 per night'; '$10 per night electric fee'), read 2026-10-28

note: GMUG campground at ~9,400 ft on a pine-and-spruce slope above Taylor Park Reservoir, south of CR 742 (Taylor Canyon Road) across from the marina; most sites look out over the reservoir to the Sawatch Range. Boat ramp just below; fishing and pontoon boat rentals at the marina. Dump station nearby. Largest of the Taylor Park campgrounds. --Claude
summary: FS page + recreation.gov: confirmed 65 sites (FS), vault toilets, potable water, no water/sewer hookups, mixed reservable/first-come, $26/$36 (2026, 2027). Changed electric 30 -> 15 (all nine electric sites list 15 amps). Added max 45 (catalog), pull-through, season note, booking.season 06-19..09-12, 14-night max, 2-night weekend minimum, 4-day cutoff. Note trimmed of field facts.

Most campsites have beautiful views of the reservoir'.
